name: Chaotic
abilities: Before each Action you perform, you may Move 1.
After your first Action on your turn, Move 1, then deal 2 damage to an enemy within range.
At the end of each turn where you performed any Actions, you may deal 1 damage to an enemy within range, then Move 2.

actions.name: Slide In
actions.text:
Teleport 2.
4+: Teleport 2 more, then you may deal 1 damage to an enemy within range.

actions.name: Left, Right!
actions.text: Deal 1 damage to an enemy within range, then you may Move 1, then you deal 2 more damage to that enemy.

description: Chaotic Freestyle is a highly aggressive skirmisher Style, focused on only two things: Dealing damage, and getting closer so you can deal damage. Chaotic Freestyle is a rushdown player's dream.
recommended: Chaotic loves Power Tokens, so Chaotic Power, Chaotic Wild, and Chaotic Thorns are clear choices. The Chaotic Ability lets you deal damage each turn you perform an Action, so Forms with off-turn Action capability like Dance, Shadow, Reversal, and Wild are all excellent options to keep up the pressure.

name: Circular
abilities: After you take damage, pay HP, or are healed, you gain 1 Speed token.
When you Bleed, gain 3 Speed tokens.

After each Dice Action you perform, if it applied Forced Movement to an enemy, they must discard 1 Basic token, if they have any. If it applied Forced Movement to an ally, they heal 1. If it moved, swapped, or teleported you, you heal 1.

actions.name: Dance Together
actions.text:
Choose someone within range. Pull them 1, then you Move 1, then you Pull them 1 more.
Usable once per turn.

actions.name: Tango
actions.text:
Swap spaces with an adjacent enemy, then Push them 1.
6+: Pull them 2, then deal 2 damage to them.
10+: Push them 4, then deal 3 damage to them.

actions.name: Dance Apart
actions.text:
Push 3 to someone within range, then Move 1.
7+: Move 2 more, then heal.

description: Circular Freestyle excels in repositioning at any moment. You slide across the battlefield as you wish, dragging along enemy and ally alike as you go. You can never be pinned down, and must always be pursued.
recommended: Circular Wild gains a Speed token after each Action you perform. Circular One-Two gives you aggression, while making all of One-Two's Action Movement heal you as you go.

name: Dangerous
abilities: At the start and end of your turn, you gain Shield 2.
After your Shield absorbs from an enemy Action, you deal 1 damage to them. If it broke your Shield, deal 2 damage instead.

actions.name: Blossoms
actions.text:
You gain Shield 2 and choose one: Gain 1 Power token; -or- Move 1; -or- heal 1.
6+: Instead, gain Shield 4 and choose two.

actions.name: Brambles
actions.text:
This is a Token Action that costs your Shield. Deal 1 damage to up to X enemies within Range 1-X, then gain 1 Power token.
X is equal to the value of the destroyed Shield.
Usable twice per turn.

description: Dangerous Freestyle is a sinister flower. Its defensive Shields are lined with thorns, damaging any foe that attacks you. But if they ignore you, your Brambles and Blossoms will grow out of control until nothing can stop you. Your foes end up in a beautiful lose/lose scenario.

name: Ego
abilities: Once per turn, when an enemy you can see gains Basic tokens, you gain 1 Power token.
You can Enhance a Hit one additional time.

actions.name: Confident Smirk
actions.text: Unblockable. Gain 1 Power token and heal 1.

actions.name: Burning Fist
actions.text: Deal 2 damage to an enemy within range, then give them Burning Tokens equal to the damage dealt to them by Burning Fist.

description: Ego Freestyle gets jealous easily. They think they can power up, right in front of you? Well two can play at that game. When you gain an odd number of Speed tokens, the Power Ability keeps the odd token out as a Speed token. So if you should gain 5 Speed tokens, you instead gain 2 Power tokens and 3 Speed tokens.

name: Eternal
abilities: At the start of your turn, discard up to 2 Status tokens you hold; then, if you are Bleeding, you heal.
At the end of your turn, choose up to two enemies within range and give them each 1 Weakness token.

actions.name: Bow Down
actions.text:
Give 1 Weakness token to an enemy within range.
4+: Give 1 Weakness token to each enemy within range.

actions.name: Stand Strong
actions.text:
1+: Give 1 Power token to an ally within range.
3+: Heal that ally.
5+: Heal and give 1 Power token to a different ally within range.
Usable once per turn.

description: Eternal Freestyle is reliability incarnate. You always know exactly what numbers you will have, and you can guarantee being alive to take your turn thanks to its start of turn heal. And if you don't need the heal, you can get rid of pesky Status tokens that would stop your plans.

name: Feral
abilities: After each Action you perform, if you are not Bleeding, pay 1 HP.
At the start of your turn, you gain 2 Power tokens.
When you Bleed, add a 4 to your Action Pool.

actions.name: Pounce
actions.text:
Pull yourself 3 towards an enemy you can see.
Usable once per turn.

actions.name: Howl
actions.text:
Gain 1 Power token, then heal 4, then give 1 Weakness token to each enemy you can see.
Usable once per turn.

description: Feral Freestyle goes hard, harder than your body can handle. You rush in with overwhelming strength, able to pile on pain and use powerful Unique Actions with ease. But if that rush of power doesn't end the fight, you're in trouble, as you are left tired, burnt out, weak, and vulnerable. So if you go this hard, you best not miss.

name: Grave
abilities: After you spend Control Tokens, you may Push 1 or Pull 1 to the enemy whose Action you Controlled.
At the start of your turn, choose one:
• Set your Range to 3-6 until your next turn.
• Set your Range to 0-3 until your next turn.

actions.name: Suppression
actions.text:
You gain 1 Control token and may Move 1.
6+: You gain 1 Control token and may Move 1.
9+: You gain 1 Control token and may Move 1.

description: Grave Freestyle has excellent range, from which it can Conrol your foes' movements and copy their Actions. Control Token: A Unique token primarily granted by Control Form. After an enemy within your range declares and pays for an Action, but before they perform it, you have an opportunity to spend Control Tokens. You may spend 1 Control Token to Copy that Action, 2 Control Tokens to Dodge that Action, or 3 Control Tokens to Parry that Action. Control Tokens may only be used once per turn. Copy: After the Action resolves, you may perform the same Action immediately, as a Reactive Action. For X Values and Gates, use a value of 4. You cannot Copy an Action that is only usable once per turn. Dodge: You or an ally within your range become immune to the Action. That Action will deal no damage, give no tokens, cause no forced movement, and apply no other effects to the one who Dodged it. Parry: The Action is negated and immediately ends. Then, you deal 2 damage to the one who used the Parried Action, and may Move up to 2. Super Moves are not Actions, and cannot be Controlled.

name: Mountainous
abilities: You have Armor.
When your Armor triggers, you gain 1 Iron token.
When you gain Speed tokens, replace half of them (rounded down) with Iron tokens.
You may spend 1 Iron token to take 1 less damage from any source (even Reduced Hits).

actions.name: Secure
actions.text: Choose two: Gain 2 Iron tokens; -or- an ally within range other than yourself gains 2 Iron tokens; -or- give Shield 2 to an ally within range.

actions.name: Contain
actions.text: Target an enemy within range, then Choose two: Challenge them; -or- Give them 2 Fatigue tokens; -or- place a Trap into their space.

actions.name: Protect
actions.text: Choose four from the Secure and Contain lists. Options from the Contain list must target an enemy within range.

description: Mountainous Freestyle is unbreakable, a dominant and incredibly tough Freestyle that can take hit after hit after hit and remain standing after it all. (The beta rulebook does not list a Range for Mountainous Freestyle; Range 1 is assumed.)

name: Mythical
abilities: Whenever you roll a 3 or less on the mythical d12 , re-roll it.
After you roll your Action Dice during your turn, you may re-roll one die. Keep the new result, even if it is worse.

actions.name: Beyond Human
actions.text:
Choose one: You Heal 2; -or- you gain 2 Power tokens; -or- discard up to 4 Status tokens among allies within range; -or- you gain Shield 3.
6+: Choose two instead.
9+: Choose three instead.
11+: Choose all four instead.

description: Mythical Freestyle is the only way to access the Mythical d12 , outside of reaching level 10. Use it wisely.

name: Persistant
abilities: At the start of your turn and when you Bleed, add a 3 to your Action Pool.
When you discard numbers from your Action Pool during the End Phase, you may keep up to two of them with a total value of 5 or less.

actions.name: Strut Your Stuff
actions.text: Pull yourself 4 towards the active character. Then, if they are an enemy, deal 1 damage to them. If they are an ally, give them 1 Iron token. Cannot be used on your own turn.

actions.name: Palm Strike
actions.text: Push 3 and deal 1 damage to an adjacent enemy.

description: Persistent Freestyle never gives up. They bide their time and can take Dice Actions at times no one else could, other than a Demon. The discard protection of the Persistent Ability can let you keep: a 4 and a 1 -or- a 3 and a 2 -or- any single number of 5 or less.

name: Secret
abilities: At the start of your turn, add 6 to your Action Pool, gain Shield 4, and you gain +3 maximum Range until the start of your next turn.
This Ability triggers only once per fight.
This Ability cannot trigger on Round 1.

actions.name: Say Hello To My Secret Weapon
actions.text:
Deal 4 damage to an enemy within range.
Usable once per fight.

description: Secret Freestyle is extremely powerful! But you can only use it once. Once you've revealed your secret weapon and spent it, you're out of luck. Hopefully you pulled it out at just the right time to make a big difference. Oh, and you can't just start the fight with your secret weapon. It isn't ready yet, you need to prepare it first.

name: Silent
abilities: At the start and end of your turn, you gain 2 Speed tokens.
At the start of each Movement Phase, you may Move 1.
You do not discard any Speed tokens during the End Phase.

actions.name: Stunt
actions.text:
Place one Fog, Copy, Pit, or Trap obstacle into an adjacent space, then teleport 2.
During enemy turns: usable once per turn.

description: Silent Freestyle skulks in the shadows, always moving and never stopping. If they catch you, they will kill you, but first: they must catch you.
